name: Central base pack: MV Act 1988 (as amended 2019) + CMVR 1989
notes: Seeded from research/ps1-current-state/02-rules-process.md (2026-10-22) and research/ps1-deep/03-lifecycle.md (2026-10-23). Rows graded MK or S-low carry verified=false and show a 'verify at your RTO' chip. Awaiting PD + BE maker-checker sign-off (MD-030).

text.en: The learner's licence test can be taken online at home with Aadhaar e-KYC, or at the RTO.

source.title: MoRTH contactless services (18 services incl. LL with online test) in effect from 3 Mar 2021

text.en: Default LL test format: 60% to pass. The 15 questions / 9 correct split is the commonly reported Sarathi default and is not checked; states configure it.

source.title: Delhi Transport LL page (60% pass mark); 15/9 Sarathi default [MK, unverified]

text.en: Watch the road-safety tutorial video within {value} days of applying (CMVR r.11, 2022 amendment).

source.title: CMVR (Sixteenth Amendment) Rules 2022, r.11 online tutorial

text.en: You can take the driving test {value} days after your learner's licence is issued.

source.title: Kashmir Life Dec 2025 (J&K) and South First (Kerala): 30 days after LL; CMVR [MK]

text.en: A learner's licence is valid for {value} months.

source.title: Delhi Transport, Learner's Licence page: LL validity 6 months

text.en: After a failed driving test, the retest is usually allowed {value} days later. Verify at your RTO.

source.title: Sarathi appointment notices (secondary, low reliability); CMVR r.15 [MK] - check on Sarathi

text.en: After a failed learner's licence test you can usually retake it {value} day later, after paying the LL retest fee. Verify at your RTO.

source.title: Delhi Transport LL page (LL retest fee); state practice varies (Gujarat 24 h, Bihar 1 week, Chandigarh 15 days)

text.en: After failing the driving test, a remedial driver-training course from a school may be required before you reappear (MV Act s.9 proviso, 2019).

source.title: MV (Amendment) Bill 2019 cl.5(iv), s.9 proviso (PRS text)

text.en: From age {value}, a medical certificate (Form 1A) from a registered doctor is needed.

source.title: Delhi Transport LL page and TN STA contactless LL flow (2022): Form 1A for applicants over 40

text.en: Driving-test format differs by state and office. We don't know it for your RTO yet.

source.title: CMVR r.15 driving test; test conduct is set by each state [MK]

text.en: There is no hazard-perception test in the central rules.

source.title: CMVR 1989 r.11 and r.15 contain no hazard-perception test [MK]

text.en: Several classes can go on one learner's licence; fees are still charged per class.

source.title: Delhi Transport LL page: LL-stage totals Rs 500 / 950 / 1,400 for 1 / 2 / 3 classes

text.en: Each class is checked on its own minimum age. Classes you can't get yet move to a later plan dated from the day you become eligible.

source.title: MV Act 1988 s.4 minimum ages per class [MK]; Delhi Transport class table

text.en: Only if you would otherwise do them one after the other: one LL for several classes saves a second application, a second 30-day wait and the per-application fees. Fees per class stay the same.

source.title: CMVR 1989 r.32 per-application fee heads (LL test, DL issue, card); fee for adding a class later is [MK]

text.en: Without Aadhaar e-KYC you upload other proofs and take the LL test at the RTO, so the plan has one more RTO visit.

source.title: TN STA contactless LL flow (2022); udayavani on non-Aadhaar route

text.en: You can apply for this class from age {minAge}.

source.title: MV Act 1988 s.4 [MK]; Delhi Transport class table (16 / 18 / 20)

text.en: At 16-17 the 50 cc licence needs your parent's or guardian's consent.

source.title: MV Act 1988 s.4(2) [MK]; Delhi Transport class table

text.en: Until 18 you can only get the gearless up-to-50 cc licence, with guardian consent.

source.title: MV Act 1988 s.4(2) [MK]; Delhi Transport class table

text.en: This class always needs a medical certificate (Form 1A).

source.title: Delhi Transport LL page; TN STA flow: Form 1A for all transport-vehicle applicants (and e-rickshaw in Delhi)

text.en: Some RTOs ask that you have held an LMV licence for a year before a transport licence. Whether the 2019 changes removed this is not checked: verify at your RTO.

source.title: MV Act s.7 as quoted by the Supreme Court in Bajaj Allianz v. Rambha Devi; 2019 change unverified

text.en: For e-rickshaw and e-cart the LL test is oral, on the same questions, instead of the computer test.

source.title: Delhi Transport LL page: e-rickshaw / e-cart oral preliminary test

text.en: Adapted vehicles have their own class. Rules and test arrangements vary: verify at your RTO.

source.title: MV Act 1988 s.10(2) invalid carriage [MK]; Sarathi Divyang category (observed 2026-10-22)

text.en: Your state does not offer the online LL test, so the LL test is at the RTO.

source.title: State LL test mode from the state pack (PRM-LL-TEST-MODE)

text.en: From 40, the RTO approves Form 1A before the LL test password is sent; the LL test is then at the RTO.

source.title: TN STA contactless LL flow (2022); Delhi Transport LL page

text.en: Applying in the Divyang category uses the non-faceless path with an RTO visit.

source.title: Sarathi LL form: Divyang category (observed 2026-10-22); product-lock blocker list

text.en: With a foreign licence you follow the LL to DL path with an RTO visit; some RTOs may exempt tests.

source.title: Foreign DL conversion rules not verified (research/ps1-deep/03-lifecycle.md section B)

text.en: Form 2: learner's licence application (made on Sarathi).

source.title: Delhi Transport LL page; TN STA flow: Form 2 generated online

text.en: Form 1: self-declaration of physical fitness (a check-box on Sarathi).

source.title: Delhi Transport LL page; TN STA flow

text.en: Form 1A: medical certificate from a registered medical practitioner.

source.title: Delhi Transport LL page; TN STA flow: over 40 and all transport

text.en: Form 1A may be needed at the driving-test stage because you turn 40 before your LL expires.

source.title: Delhi Transport LL page; TN STA flow (Form 1A over 40); EC-04

text.en: Proof of age and address (Aadhaar e-KYC fills these in), self-attested if uploaded.

source.title: CMVR r.4 [MK]; TN STA flow: Aadhaar e-KYC fills name, DOB, address, photo

text.en: A document with your full date of birth (birth certificate, Class 10 certificate or passport).

source.title: Council verification list: Aadhaar with year of birth only (stored as 1 Jan) [MK]

text.en: Proof of where you live now (rent agreement, utility bill or another proof your state accepts).

source.title: TN STA contactless LL flow: non-Aadhaar route needs separate address proof

text.en: A document that shows your father's, mother's or guardian's name, for the non-Aadhaar path.

source.title: India Herald, 19 Feb 2026: relation-name field blank from Aadhaar (news report, not a rule)

text.en: Photo and signature (on the Aadhaar path only the signature is uploaded).

source.title: Sarathi upload photo and signature screen (observed 2026-10-22)

text.en: Written consent of a parent or guardian.

source.title: MV Act 1988 s.4(2) [MK]; Delhi Transport class table

text.en: Some states still list an 8th-pass certificate for transport classes; MoRTH reportedly dropped it in 2019. Verify at your RTO.

source.title: Delhi Transport class table lists 8th pass; 2019 removal [MK]

text.en: Your valid learner's licence (Form 3, PDF is fine).

source.title: CMVR r.14 DL application within LL validity [MK]; J&K guides

text.en: For the test vehicle: RC, insurance, PUC, and L plates.

source.title: J&K guides; CMVR r.3 L plate [MK]

text.en: No licence class is open before 16. The earliest is the 50 cc gearless licence at 16, with guardian consent.

source.title: MV Act 1988 s.4 [MK]; Delhi Transport class table

text.en: Your Aadhaar shows only the year. Systems may read your birthday as 1 January. Bring another date-of-birth document. Your dates here use 31 December so you are never shown as older than you are.

source.title: Council verification list: Aadhaar with year of birth only (stored as 1 Jan) [MK]

text.en: Your Aadhaar address is not where you live. Either apply with another address proof (non-Aadhaar path, one more RTO visit) or update your Aadhaar address and then use the contactless path.

source.title: TN STA contactless LL flow: RTO auto-assigned from the Aadhaar PIN code

text.en: The relation-name field may come back blank and locked from Aadhaar. Options: update Aadhaar, or use the non-Aadhaar path with an RTO visit. Ask your RTO which they accept.

source.title: India Herald, 19 Feb 2026 (news report, not a rule)

text.en: You are 40 or older, so you need a medical certificate (Form 1A) before applying.

source.title: Delhi Transport LL page; TN STA flow: Form 1A over 40

text.en: You turn 40 before your learner's licence expires. If your driving test is on or after that day, Form 1A may be needed.

source.title: Delhi Transport LL page; TN STA flow: Form 1A over 40

text.en: At 16-17 you can only get a licence for a gearless vehicle up to 50 cc, with your guardian's consent. Most scooters are above 50 cc.

source.title: MV Act 1988 s.4(2) [MK]; Delhi Transport class table

text.en: Use Margdarshak inside a parent's or guardian's account (family mode); the adult account holder gives consent.

source.title: DPDP Act 2023: verifiable parental consent for under-18s [MK]

text.en: The 50 cc class covers only vehicles up to 50 cc. Check the cc on your vehicle's RC: most scooters need the 'scooter without gears' (MCWOG) class.

source.title: Delhi Transport class table (MCWOG up to 50 cc at 16)

text.en: Not yet: transport licences start at 20.

source.title: MV Act 1988 s.4 [MK]; Delhi Transport class table (20 for transport)

text.en: Other conditions (for example, holding an LMV licence for a year) vary: verify at your RTO. An accredited driver-training centre certificate is another path.

source.title: MV Act s.7 as quoted in Bajaj Allianz v. Rambha Devi (SC); 2019 change unverified

text.en: LMV licence holders may drive transport vehicles up to 7,500 kg (Supreme Court, 6 Nov 2024). Verify for commercial use.

source.title: SC Observer: Bajaj Allianz v. Rambha Devi, judgment of 6 Nov 2024

text.en: Your state does not offer the online LL test. Book an LL test slot at the RTO and bring your documents.

source.title: State LL test mode from the state pack (PRM-LL-TEST-MODE)

text.en: The Aadhaar path sends an OTP to the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar. Link your mobile at an Aadhaar centre, or use the non-Aadhaar path.

source.title: Sarathi Aadhaar OTP screen: 'Aadhaar holder should have registered mobile number' (observed 2026-10-22)

text.en: The home LL test needs a laptop or desktop with a webcam, Chrome or Edge, and pop-ups allowed. Without one, take the test at the RTO.

source.title: Sarathi LL test sign-in and face-authentication screens (observed 2026-10-22)

text.en: Your rights: an adapted-vehicle class exists, accessible formats can be asked for, and the Divyang path includes an RTO visit.

source.title: Sarathi Divyang category (observed); MoRTH advisories via Puducherry Transport circular, Nov 2023

text.en: MoRTH advisories say driving is primarily a visual function; loss of hearing does not by itself stop you from getting a licence.

source.title: MoRTH advisories 14-06-2016, 28-10-2016, letter of 06-11-2023, quoted in Puducherry Transport circular

text.en: Colour-vision questions may come up in the medical self-declaration and sign questions. Ask for a text alternative; rules vary, verify at your RTO.

source.title: Form 1 / Form 1A fitness declarations [MK]

text.en: No direct conversion found; you follow the LL to DL path. Some RTOs may exempt tests.

source.title: Foreign DL conversion not verified (research/ps1-deep/03-lifecycle.md section B)

text.en: NRI applicants use the same LL to DL path with an Indian address proof; document rules vary, verify at your RTO.

source.title: NRI rules not verified (research/ps1-deep/03-lifecycle.md gaps)

text.en: A learner's licence is issued by a state. If you move, the plan is re-checked against the new state's rules; transfer or re-applying depends on the state.

source.title: MV (Amendment) Act 2019: apply to any licensing authority in the State [MK]

text.en: An International Driving Permit is only for people who already hold an Indian driving licence.

source.title: Sarathi IDP service needs a valid DL, passport and visa [MK]

text.en: You can apply for an International Driving Permit on Sarathi with your DL, passport and visa.

source.title: Sarathi IDP service, valid 1 year [MK]

text.en: You need a vehicle of the class for the driving test, with RC, insurance, PUC and L plates. A driving school can provide one.

source.title: J&K guides; CMVR r.3 L plate [MK]

text.en: Check your photo and signature before you pay: they can't be replaced later in the application.

source.title: Sarathi upload photo and signature screen (observed 2026-10-22)

text.en: Your learner's licence has expired. Apply for a fresh LL; a new application number means an old slot will not carry over.

source.title: Delhi Transport LL page: LL validity 6 months

text.en: Your learner's licence expires within 30 days. Book a driving-test date before it expires.

source.title: Delhi Transport LL page: LL validity 6 months

text.en: An accredited driver-training centre (ADTC) course can replace the RTO driving test. The LL stage still applies; how many centres operate near you is unknown.

source.title: MoRTH ADTC rules effective 1 Jul 2021 (Tribune/PTI)

text.en: Your state may add a service charge or postage on top of these government fees.

source.title: CMVR 1989 r.32 covers central fee heads only; state charges vary

text.en: Partial: we have only some rules for your state. Verify at your RTO.

source.title: Margdarshak rule-pack coverage (partial state pack)
